description_en: Queries the status of a data migration task. This is a legacy operation
description_zh: 老版查询数据迁移任务的状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-migration-job-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtsxxxxxxxx --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMigrationJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration instance. You can call the DescribeMigrationJobs operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeMigrationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

DataInitializationStatus.description_en: The execution status of full data migration
DataInitializationStatus.description_zh: 全量数据迁移执行状态

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when full data migration failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 全量数据迁移失败的错误提示

Percent.description_en: The progress of full data migration, in percentage
Percent.description_zh: 全量数据迁移进度，单位为百分比

Progress.description_en: The number of records that have been migrated during initial full data synchronization
Progress.description_zh: 已完成全量数据初始化的记录数

Status.description_en:
The status of full data migration. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Migrating: migrating.
Failed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed
Status.description_zh:
全量数据迁移状态，取值包括：

NotStarted：未启动。
Migrating：迁移中。
Failed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成

DataSynchronizationStatus.description_en: The execution status of incremental data migration
DataSynchronizationStatus.description_zh: 增量数据迁移执行状态

Checkpoint.description_en: The timestamp of the latest incremental data that has been migrated. The value is a UNIX timestamp, in seconds
Checkpoint.description_zh: 迁移最新一条增量数据的时间戳，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒

Delay.description_en: The migration latency of incremental data migration, in seconds
Delay.description_zh: 增量数据迁移延迟，单位为秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when incremental data migration failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 增量数据迁移失败的错误提示
ErrorMessage.example: 任务失败太久 无法恢复

Percent.description_en: The progress of incremental data migration, in percentage
Percent.description_zh: 增量数据迁移进度，单位为百分比

Status.description_en:
The status of incremental data migration. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Migrating: migrating.
Failed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed.
Catched: no latency
Status.description_zh:
增量数据迁移状态，取值包括：

NotStarted：未启动。
Migrating：迁移中。
Failed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成。
Catched：无延迟

DestinationEndpoint.description_en: The connection information of the destination instance

DatabaseName.description_en: The name of the database to which the objects to be migrated belong in the destination instance
DatabaseName.description_zh: 目标实例中待迁移对象所属数据库的名称

EngineName.description_en: The database type of the destination instance
EngineName.description_zh: 目标实例的数据库类型

IP.description_en: The endpoint of the destination instance

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the destination instance

InstanceType.description_en: The type of the destination instance

Port.description_en: The database service port of the destination instance
Port.description_zh: 目标实例的数据库服务端口

UserName.description_en: The database account of the destination instance
UserName.description_zh: 目标实例的数据库账号

oracleSID.description_en:
The SID of the Oracle database.
This parameter is returned only when the database type of the destination instance is Oracle
oracleSID.description_zh:
Oracle数据库的SID信息。
当目标实例的数据库类型为Oracle时，才会返回该参数

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

MigrationJobClass.description_en: The specification of the data migration instance. Valid values: small, medium, large, xlarge, and 2xlarge. For more information, see [Specifications of data migration instances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html）
MigrationJobClass.description_zh: 数据迁移实例的规格，返回值为：small、medium、large、xlarge或2xlarge。更多规格说明，请参见[数据迁移链路规格说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html）

MigrationJobId.description_en: The instance ID of the data migration instance

MigrationJobName.description_en: The name of the data migration instance

MigrationJobStatus.description_en:
The status of the data migration task. Valid values:
NotStarted: not started.
Prechecking: running the precheck.
PrecheckFailed: precheck failed.
Migrating: migrating.
Suspending: paused.
MigrationFailed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed
MigrationJobStatus.description_zh:
迁移任务状态，返回值：
NotStarted：未启动。
Prechecking：预检查中。
PrecheckFailed：预检查失败。
Migrating：迁移中。
Suspending：暂停中。
MigrationFailed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成

dataInitialization.description_en:
Indicates whether full data migration is performed. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
dataInitialization.description_zh:
是否迁移全量数据，取值：

true：是。
false：否

dataSynchronization.description_en:
Indicates whether incremental data migration is performed. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
dataSynchronization.description_zh:
是否迁移增量数据，取值：

true：是。
false：否

structureInitialization.description_en:
Indicates whether schema migration is performed. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
structureInitialization.description_zh:
是否执行结构迁移，取值：

true：是。
false：否

PayType.description_en: The billing method of the data migration task. The return value is fixed as PostPaid (pay-as-you-go)
PayType.description_zh: 迁移任务的付费类型，返回值固定为PostPaid（按量付费）

Percent.description_en: The overall progress of the precheck, in percentage
Percent.description_zh: 预检查整体进度，单位为百分比

Status.description_en:
The precheck status. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Checking: running the precheck.
Failed: precheck failed.
Finished: precheck completed
Status.description_zh:
预检查状态，返回值：

NotStarted：未启动。
Checking：预检查中。
Failed：预检查失败。
Finished：预检查完成

SourceEndpoint.description_en: The connection information of the source instance

DatabaseName.description_en: The name of the database to which the objects to be migrated belong in the source instance
DatabaseName.description_zh: 源实例中待迁移对象所属数据库的名称

EngineName.description_en: The database type of the source instance

IP.description_en: The endpoint of the source instance

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the source instance

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the source instance. Valid values:

RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
ECS: self-managed database hosted on ECS.
LocalInstance: self-managed database with a public IP address.
Express: self-managed database connected over Express Connect, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.
MongoDB: ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.
POLARDB: PolarDB for MySQL cluster (this value is applicable only to the China site)
InstanceType.description_zh:
源库的实例类型，返回值：

RDS：阿里云RDS实例。
ECS：ECS上的自建数据库。
LocalInstance：有公网IP的自建数据库。
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的自建数据库。
MongoDB：阿里云MongoDB实例。
POLARDB：阿里云POLARDB for MySQL集群（该值仅适用于中国站）

Port.description_en: The database service port of the source instance
Port.description_zh: 源实例的数据库服务端口

UserName.description_en: The database account of the source instance

oracleSID.description_en:
The SID of the Oracle database.
This parameter is returned only when the database type of the source instance is Oracle
oracleSID.description_zh:
Oracle数据库的SID信息。
当迁移的源库的数据库类型为Oracle时，才会返回本参数

StructureInitializationStatus.description_en: The execution status of schema migration

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when schema migration failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 结构迁移失败的错误提示
ErrorMessage.example: DTS-1020042 Execute sql error sql: ERROR: type "geometry" does not exist;

Percent.description_en: The progress of schema migration, in percentage
Percent.description_zh: 结构迁移进度，单位为百分比

Progress.description_en: The number of tables for which schema migration has been completed
Progress.description_zh: 已完成结构迁移的表的数量

Status.description_en:
The status of schema migration. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Migrating: migrating.
Failed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed
Status.description_zh:
结构迁移状态，取值包括：

NotStarted：未启动。
Migrating：迁移中。
Failed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the data migration task
